items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: She played time. Well, during that time Joe Betty was playing trumpet then... Joe was a good leader.

ctx.x: And then she, was she a good drummer? Yeah, she played nice drums.

She played really nice drums. Yeah. She played time. Well, during that time Joe Betty was playing trumpet then. Nice trumpet player. But Joe Betty was using dope and every time he'd go on a job he'd pull his arm for that dope. That's for running him crazy. I've never seen Joe with a woman in my life. Never. And Joe was a good leader.
Yeah. And when did he die?
